name: Peace Spiritual
overview: Scripture reveals that true spiritual peace is a divine blessing bestowed by the LORD, who lifts His countenance upon His people to grant them safety and rest, as seen in Numbers 6:26 and Psalms 4:8. This peace is intimately connected to an acquaintance with God, promising good to those who seek Him (Job 22:21), and it is a source of strength and blessing for His people (Psalms 29:11). Furthermore, God's peace brings quietness that no trouble can overcome, highlighting its sovereign and sustaining nature (Job 34:29).
